an10.92:1.1: athakho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an10.92:2.1: yato kho gahapati ariyasāvakassa pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti ariyo cassa ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
an10.92:2.2: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
an10.92:3.1: katamāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti
an10.92:3.2: yaṃ gahapati pāṇātipātī pāṇātipātapaccayā diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati samparāyikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti pāṇātipātā paṭivirato neva diṭṭhadhammikaṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati na samparāyikaṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an10.92:3.3: pāṇātipātā paṭiviratassa evantaṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ vūpasantaṃ hoti
an10.92:4.4: surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānapaccayā diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati samparāyikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato neva diṭṭhadhammikaṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati na samparāyikaṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an10.92:4.5: surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratassa evantaṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ vūpasantaṃ hoti
an10.92:4.6: imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti.
an10.92:5.2: idha gahapati ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
an10.92:5.3: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
an10.92:5.5: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti
an10.92:5.7: supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho ujupaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho ñāyapaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho sāmīcipaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā esa bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti
an10.92:5.8: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi acchiddehi asabalehi akammāsehi bhujjissehi viññūpasaṭṭhehi aparāmaṭṭhehi samādhisaṃvattanikehi
an10.92:6.1: katamo cassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho
an10.92:6.3: iti imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti imassuppādā idaṃ uppajjati
an10.92:6.4: imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhati yadidaṃ
an10.92:6.17: avijjāya tveva asesavirāganirodhā saṃkhāranirodho saṃkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho nāmarūpanirodhā saḷāyatananirodho saḷāyatananirodhā phassanirodho phassanirodhā vedanānirodho vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho bhavanirodhā jātinirodho jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti
an10.92:6.19: ayañcassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho.
an10.92:7.1: yato kho gahapati ariyasāvakassa imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti imehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti ayañcassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
an10.92:7.2: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
